name: Craft.io
title: craft.io
shortDescription: Craft.io is a comprehensive product management platform designed to streamline the entire product lifecycle. It is tailored for product teams aiming to strategize, align, and execute their visions effectively. Users can collect feedback, prioritize features, and manage portfolios seamlessly. An example use case involves a product manager using Craft.io to create a roadmap linked to company OKRs, ensuring strategic alignment and clear communication across teams.
pros: Seamless integration with other dev tools
cons: May be complex for small teams
